question: Create a blank hospital-automation-robotics workflow named my_workflow.
ground_truth: This authoring prompt routes to fast blank Workflow creation and produces a complete idle-only scaffold without selecting a robot, task, source Workflow, or policy.
expected_behavior: routes to i4h-workflow-create
runs ./scripts/create_blank_environment.py for my_workflow with --specialty hospital-automation-robotics
creates the Scene assets, Scene class, scene manifest, idle workflow, and contract test
generates a contract test for durable workflow and manifest invariants that remains valid after later assets, robots, cameras, tasks, or modes are added
creates only a ground plane and dome light
does not inspect or fork an existing workflow
does not add or declare a robot, policy, task manifest, object, or camera
does not boot Isaac Sim
runs show and lint for idle, lint --all, the generated contract test, and the shared zero-DOF blank-scene runtime test
leaves later world and behavior authoring to scene-edit and task-specific work

question: Make me a new laparoscopic-robotics workflow called training_sandbox as fast as possible. Start blank.
ground_truth: The request creates a complete blank training_sandbox workflow and Scene through the fast idle-only generator.
expected_behavior: routes to i4h-workflow-create
uses training_sandbox as the workflow and Scene id under laparoscopic-robotics
uses the shared executable Python utility to create the five overwrite-safe blank Workflow files in one command
exposes exactly idle mode
does not make the generated contract test permanently assert that the workflow remains blank
performs only fast static validation

question: Create a blank i4h workflow named recovery_room.
ground_truth: The workflow cannot be created until the user chooses one approved product specialty.

asks the user to choose laparoscopic-robotics, ultrasound-robotics, endoluminal-robotics, or hospital-automation-robotics
does not infer a specialty from recovery_room
does not run the generator or create files before the user chooses

question: Create a blank workflow named ultrasound_liver_scan under hospital-automation-robotics.
ground_truth: The public workflow id ultrasound_liver_scan already exists under ultrasound-robotics, so creation must stop before any files are written.
expected_behavior: routes to i4h-workflow-create
runs the blank Workflow generator with ultrasound_liver_scan and hospital-automation-robotics
lets the generator detect the existing public id across all specialty directories before writing files
reports workflows/i4h_workflows/ultrasound-robotics/ultrasound_liver_scan.py from the generator error
